exposure: Urgency of cesarean section (elective or emergency)
Scheduled order on the operation list
outcome: Fasting times for food and drink
Fasting for both food >12 h and fluids >4 h
cohort: 279 consecutive women undergoing cesarean birth at Helsinki University Women's Hospital, Finland, during January-February 2023
finding: Increasing urgency of cesarean section was associated with shorter fasting times, while fasting times for elective cesareans increased with later scheduled order on the daily list.
